essence: The rite is to be carried out annually in the month of Āśvayuja.
The preferred time is the twelfth day of the bright fortnight.
An alternative timing is allowed and its procedure is explained in this context.
The sacrificial hall is declared to be twenty cubits with equal length.
An altar half that size is regarded as the proper one for kings.
